Ivar meets Melantha (hopefully alone) on the balcony outside her room. He stands calmly, unarmed, with two owlin laying on the ground beside him. His hair has gone from black to almost pure white, with streaks of black running through it.
"Don't worry, I am unarmed, and they are just unconscious."

"I came here to ask you one more time to join me. I know you've been through a lot, seen a lot, and maybe you finally can see the world as I do. You've suffered, even some of that came from my father, the same man who made me and my siblings suffer for so long. Help me kill him, end his tyranny, help me get my revenge."

If she refuses: "I should have known better. One of Kagerra's faithful, highborn elf, you could never understand the world the way a puny human does. I'm leaving, don't try to stop me, I don't want to kill you here. And don't you dare judge me, you made a deal with someone to get your power, I did the same thing. Arkonil was the only god that ever answered me, and I'm going to get justice."

If she agrees: "I only want him dead, after that we can arrange for... the future. I will contact you again after convergence."
